page.overview:
Who is Extovass?

Extovass the Gluttonous was a nalfeshnee demon and a servant of Vrudauliun. As an NPC, Extovass was played by Matthew Mercer.

Extovass had a corpulent, dark-furred body standing about 13 feet tall, with massive, long-clawed arms, a wide jaw held in an ape-like grimace exposing massive tusks and teeth, small furry wings, and tiny legs that caused it to walk with an awkward gait.

Bells Hells encountered Extovass at the Iridon Bastion in the Grey Valley of Tal'Dorei, where he was planning to celebrate a feast after having taken the fort from the followers of Bahamut. He had taken several prisoners, and intended to use them (either as food or as sacrifices) and bring more fiendish forces to that place.

The demon succeeded in knocking Imogen Temult unconscious but was driven away and killed by Fearne Calloway shortly thereafter. The rescued prisoners told the party Extovass's name and said that he had yielded himself to a demon prince named Vrudauliun.
